other_conditions: Only two siblings within a family are eligible for this benefit
Trainee must maintain an average of 80% attendance
Trainee should be passing the first year to enroll in a 2‑year trade
Trainees suspended or found non‑eligible for the All India Trade Test (AITT) are not qualified
Trainees who have left the GITI are not eligible from their date of departure
Trainees in PITI are ineligible for this scheme
Applicant must have an Aadhaar‑seeded savings bank account in a nationalised bank
Trainee registration on the MAHA‑DBT portal is compulsory
